question: Fills mean different things for small and large residuals
newly_quantified_finding: At +5ms, one-lot starts with observed fills survived to +25ms in 69/76 cases (90.8%); without fills, 361/703 (51.4%). For larger starts the comparison reverses: 150/269 (55.8%) versus 978/1396 (70.1%). The direction of both contrasts holds on all four dates.
contrary_or_limiting_evidence: All 76 one-lot filled survivors had source-accounted implied added display by the decision, with zero unmatched fills. Price direction after observation remains mixed; larger filled survivors have negative mean 20s oriented changes on all four dates.
paper_implication: Recommend R2 observation-only pending a direct test of the complete price-confirmed rule; log initial display, residual and replenishment separately.
measured_warning_lead: Not established; source intervals/recognition delays/outcome horizons are separate quantities

question: The cause of a flow flip changes its short-term persistence
newly_quantified_finding: After sign flips caused by classified arrivals without expiry, 5s same-sign persistence is 80.6–83.0% across dates; expiry without classified arrivals gives 62.0–65.8%. At 20s the advantage shrinks and is slightly reversed on Oct 3.
contrary_or_limiting_evidence: This concerns rolling flow state, not price. Window aging mechanically explains part of the contrast; unknown-side prints may still occur.
evidence: P01; all 316,800 seconds; independent loop recount
paper_implication: Retain fresh/expiry/mixed provenance and update the state continuously; do not turn persistence into a price-return claim.
measured_warning_lead: Not established; source intervals/recognition delays/outcome horizons are separate quantities

question: Missing recent flow does not mean an empty market state
newly_quantified_finding: Fresh 5s flow is missing in 2,367/3,176 recognition contexts. With nonzero touch imbalance and available 20s outcomes in that group, touch-oriented means are positive on all four dates; they remain positive in the 60s-separated subset.
contrary_or_limiting_evidence: On identical jointly defined rows, touch beats fresh flow at 20s on three dates and loses on Oct 18. The small midpoint effects are not net executable returns.
evidence: Exact P09–P10 candidate/time join; no unmatched identities
paper_implication: Retain quiet-flow book/price observations. R1 fresh-flow gating remains a hypothesis to evaluate, not universal decision coverage.
measured_warning_lead: Not established; source intervals/recognition delays/outcome horizons are separate quantities

question: Short-flow direction depends on the longer flow state
newly_quantified_finding: Family 5s/60s flow agreement produces higher 20s flow-oriented mean movement than disagreement on all four dates: differences 0.709, 0.461, 0.119 and 0.485 ticks. Disagreement itself is negative on Oct 2/3 and positive on Oct 17/18.
contrary_or_limiting_evidence: Retrospective family selection and an outcome reference before the family start include onset mechanics. This does not test R1 execution or isolate causality. The agreement advantage also holds at 5s, but reverses at 60s on Oct 17 and Oct 18; it is horizon-dependent.
evidence: P02 complete families; P03 pressure/side/volume and separated-event comparisons
paper_implication: Useful context for the R1 hypothesis, with disagreement retained for comparison. No threshold optimization or new performance promise.
measured_warning_lead: Not established; source intervals/recognition delays/outcome horizons are separate quantities

question: How a quote became thin changes the interpretation
newly_quantified_finding: The pooled origin comparison mixes NEW_BEST with STANDING_BEST_SHRANK. Within first-observed orders whose standing best shrank, size-cut origins retreat more often than older-resting origins on every date. Older resting at NEW_BEST is not uniformly worse than fresh adds.
contrary_or_limiting_evidence: Origin and onset mechanism are strongly entangled. The same one-lot size is not the same state. Outcomes describe the source quote episode, not our trade PnL.
evidence: P07 all 101,066 onsets; 89,072 unique day/order first observations
paper_implication: Log onset mechanism and prior history; avoid a generic one-lot weakness trigger.

question: Apparent confirmation often repeats the same execution

contrary_or_limiting_evidence: The 137-field screen is exploratory and highly dependent. Small associations remain visible; no row-level significance or best-feature claim is used.
evidence: P02 field screen, all 548 field/day comparisons and redundancy checks

question: Birth-aligned buildup and recognition-time information differ
newly_quantified_finding: At −5s from retrospective birth, median birth-oriented lean is 0.419–0.500 versus zero in matched-control medians. Yet defined-flow share at −5s is near the controls and at recognition fresh flow is often empty.
contrary_or_limiting_evidence: Birth identity and orientation are retrospective; control bands summarize 200 draws, not independent-day confidence. Prebirth 20s total-volume differences are below controls on all four dates, while direction/depth differences vary.
evidence: P06 matched pairs + P08 all 404 cohort/control boundary pairs + P09/P10
paper_implication: Retain formation explanations without presenting future-aligned curves as an online early warning or sufficient market model.
